label: Long Sword
note: MH3U's standard quick-blade G-rank mix (Narga Z / Silver Sol / Nether) runs Honed Blade (Sharpness+1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp and Evasion+1, with Challenger+2, Weakness Exploit or HGE as common swaps. Only Honed Blade's static Sharpness+1 and +20 true raw are modeled; Razor Sharp, Evasion+1, Challenger+2, Weakness Exploit and HGE are unmodeled.
